answer: Each new identity must post a refundable bond before receiving work; outputs are randomly routed to independent agents for cross-checking. A false answer or collusion discovered by an audit burns the bond and lowers reputation, so creating many Sybils multiplies locked capital and expected losses rather than influence. Honest agents recover their stake and earn fees, while an attacker must fund every persona named vine, ivory, or karst long enough to look credible.
